frozen_acceptance.source:
# Heading experiment acceptance

- Preserve DroneHover mass, motor forces, disturbed resets, contact termination,
  and the qualified twelve-feature checkpoint.
- HeadingTask changes reward only. Heading is fixed world negative Z.
- Actor input is twelve body-frame flight quantities plus signed yaw error/pi.
  No target character state, sight, hearing, or arena data enters this lesson.
- Transfer inserts one zero-weight feature. Existing mean actions and memory
  must match the original actor before training. Critic and optimizer start fresh.
- This private lesson introduces no public library API or live game behavior.
- Actor learning rate is 0.0001; other healthy recipe settings are retained.
- Reward multiplies healthy reward by 0.25 + 0.75*(1 - forward.z)/2.
  Forward is a unit direction. This factor ranges from 0.25 to 1.
- Training uses eight independent lanes, 64 actions each, and 500-action episodes.
  Existing training seed exclusion and GAE rules apply unchanged.
- Selection requires all five existing selection seeds to survive 500 actions,
  earn reward >=400, end within 0.5 metres, and spend the final 100 actions
  within 0.5 metres and 15 degrees of world north. No threshold may loosen after
  seeing results. Qualification also needs frozen, separate high-bit seeds.
- Commands: focused tests, cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo test,
  cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, changed-line personal
  lint, explicit branch/line coverage, runnable guide and documentation tests.
- Existing game continues using qualified healthy hover. Do not promote a
  checkpoint solely because a training command completed.

residual_heading.boundary: Frozen healthy flight policy plus learned scalar diagonal motor trim, bounded to [-0.15, 0.15]; clamp final motor fractions to [0, 1]. This does not guarantee stability.
residual_heading.actor_inputs: Existing twelve flight features plus signed yaw error/pi; no character coordinates.
residual_heading.architecture: LSTM hidden size 16, critic [32,32], scalar action; healthy recipe except initial log std -1.0.
residual_heading.settled_counter_comparison: distance < 0.5f32 and abs(yaw_error / pi) < 0.083333336f32; reset counter to zero after either fails

validation.native: All archived probes compiled and ran; direct and bounded waypoint probes completed. Actor insertion preserved action and recurrent output exactly for the checked seed. A separate temporary regression checked all five selection seeds and unchanged physics and termination; all seven tests including shared units passed.
